phase1.instructions: Use only the tools returned by tools/list. Follow the phase-one production skills via resources/list and resources/read (openmotion://workflow/production/start or the selected specialist); engine authoring guidance is openmotion://engine/SKILL.md and relative Markdown references under openmotion://engine/. Read the selected project and current content version before editing. Save native source through openmotion_edit_project; preview and export perform their required checks internally. Use openmotion_list_versions to find project snapshots and openmotion_restore_version to restore one as a new version while retaining later history. A transport cancellation does not prove a background export stopped. Report actual export state and accessible results; technical validation does not replace visual, audio and player review. Never guess a project from another conversation or workspace. For new work create explicitly; openmotion_open_preview never silently creates a project. Use openmotion_open_preview target=templates for the editor template library without any project/session/version binding; browse first and create only after user selection. Persisted create/import/edit/restore/export/cancel and review requests require a stable requestId; preview action=open does not. Edits require projectId, expectedRevision and expectedVersionId. Query export progress through openmotion_get_project with projectId and exportJobId. Project list and version list are five per page; follow nextCursor. For cloud asset imports, use openmotion_import_assets with action=prepare_upload + upload_ticket, public HTTPS url, or zero-copy library_asset (local host paths are unsupported in cloud mode). For NEW generated media, use openmotion_media_use inspect/reference/models to discover OpenDesign platform models, then openmotion_assets_use generate with the full model ID, status with the original jobId, get/read at a pinned assetId/versionId, and import_to_project only for selected film assets. Recover failed or interrupted tasks with resume using the original jobId and a stable requestId without submitting another paid generation. Unknown outcomes require original-job inspection, never automatic resubmission. Use openmotion_project_archive to export editable project ZIPs. Follow its tool description for the supported ZIP import path. Use openmotion_manage_project for info, rename, duplicate, trash, restore and delete (cloud P2 features such as review comments, mutating openmotion_design_* projects, headless brand_kit website capture, and unconfigured ASR transcription return explicit FEATURE_DEFERRED_P2).
